text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, while I'm walking down the
hallway, I
notice Rice Shower looking
rather gloomy.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Oh... What do I do? What do I do...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Um... Nothing happened, but... Well, the
weather
forecast says there'll be heavy
rain tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I was planning to train a lot tomorrow
since I've
got a race coming up, but
now... Oh, I don't know
what to do!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It won't be the same as running on a
track, but I
suggest she train in the gym
so she can practice
her acceleration in
straight sprints.
choice_data_list: 体育館を借りて走ろう！
てるてる坊主を作ろう！

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
But if I rent it out for myself, doesn't
that mean
nobody else will be able to
use the gym?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I suggest that she invite other
Umamusume to
train with her, and she
seems much happier with
the idea after
that.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that makes sense! Thanks for your

suggestion! Ehehe, I'm excited to run
tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And with that, her training session goes
off
without a hitch.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
That's a great idea! I'm sure the skies will
clear if
we make a lot of them.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Let's make really cute ones. I want to
make a blue
one...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Oh! But... No, this won't work...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
If I make them, they'll probably just
bring a whole
storm down on us
instead...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Really? What a relief! I'm sure they'll work fine if you do it! I'll make the best sunshine dolls I can!
choice_data_list: 俺もいっぱい作るから、大丈夫
私もいっぱい作るから、大丈夫

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The skies must have heard Rice Shower's
pleas,
because there isn't a single cloud
to be seen the
next day.
